attestation: I read AGENTS.md §1 for orientation and kept to the brief, C82 captures, and my own walk rig and output. I did not encounter earlier audits or save a friction note. I extracted navigation and headings from all 194 matrix accessibility trees and 20 runtime frames. I reviewed native-scale crops from all 194 matrix first screens, 492 matrix scroll frames, and 20 runtime screenshots, with original uncropped screenshots and layout data for selected evidence. The visual review sampled the navigation and landmarks in each frame. I used Demo User in the live browser with rendered dark at 1440×900 and light at 375×812. I quit the daemon, sent TERM to its process group, and verified ports 4327 and 5327 were released. I did not restart the rig for the capture review.
